title: Synchronize approved GitHub Issues with Agent Mesh work items
description: Import and link approved GitHub Issues as MESH work items, synchronize lifecycle state, and document the Issue → MESH → PR workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Approved GitHub Issues can be imported or linked idempotently as MESH work items.
Linked work items persist their GitHub Issue URL and number and reject unapproved or unready Issues.
Issue, MESH work item, and PR lifecycle status can be synchronized.
Tests and documentation cover the provider workflow.
